explanation: Compared against Written on the Wall II (archived all.html and wowIIdefs.js via the Wayback Machine), Conjecture 84 (status O): 'If G is a simple connected graph, then tree(G) ≥ 2 rad(G)/δ(G)', with definitions 48 (tree(G): number of vertices of a largest induced tree), 13 (rad(G): minimum eccentricity) and 56 (δ(G): minimum degree). The Lean statement for connected G on a finite nontrivial type: 2·rad(G)/δ(G) ≤ largestInducedTreeSize G, with radius converted via toNat (finite for connected graphs) and an explicit 0 < minDegree hypothesis, which is automatic for connected graphs with ≥ 2 vertices. Faithful.
